description:
Analyze the HEC-RAS unsteady simulation results for the Muncie project to determine flow distribution. 

1. Locate the HDF5 results file (Muncie.p04.hdf or similar) in the project directory.
2. Write a Python script to extract hydraulic data. You need to calculate the percentage of flow in the Left Overbank (LOB), Main Channel, and Right Overbank (ROB) for each cross-section at the timestep with the PEAK total flow.
3. Your script should save a CSV file to `/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/flow_distribution.csv` with these columns: `CrossSection`, `Total_Flow_cms`, `LOB_Flow_Pct`, `Channel_Flow_Pct`, `ROB_Flow_Pct`.
4. Also create a summary text file `/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/flow_split_summary.txt` listing the peak timestep index used and the name of the cross-section with the highest overbank flow percentage.

Note: If sub-section flow is not explicitly available, you may calculate it using Flow Area and Velocity columns (Q = V * A) or Conveyance ratios if applicable.
